title: Chapter 481: The Fall Of The Truni Empire
content:
Chapter 481: The Fall Of The Truni Empire

Let this eternal queen die with dignity.

Wang Shuo wanted to give the other party enough respect.

So he said: "Queen Anna, if you have any tricks, just use them. Once I use my tricks later, you may not have a chance."

"Hmph, don't be hypocritical."

The smile on Wang Shuo's face disappeared, holding the gun with both hands, he chopped hard.

A huge knife light, stretching for dozens of meters, smashed down at Queen Anna.

Queen Anna immediately used her foot knife to resist.

But they were cut off one by one.

Fortunately, the power of this knife was not too great. Although all the foot knives were broken, Queen Anna was not seriously injured.

Seeing this, Wang Shuo no longer hesitated and shouted "Great Dragon".

In an instant, a dragon roared in the sky.

A huge golden dragon with a length of dozens of meters circled in the air.

The soldiers around were all shocked.

"This... This is a dragon."

The golden dragon circled in the air twice, found Queen Anna, and swooped down directly.

At the same time, a sound wave came out of the golden dragon's mouth. Queen Anna forgot to move for a moment, and a look of horror appeared on her face.

The golden dragon carried an overwhelming momentum and directly submerged Queen Anna.

After the golden dragon disappeared, the smoke dissipated.

Queen Anna stood there blankly, her eyes were empty, and blood was flowing from her seven orifices.

Countless people held their breath when they saw this scene.

Queen Anna's figure turned into faint starlight and dissipated between heaven and earth.

Wang Shuo was a little puzzled, whether this Queen Anna was dead or not.

But the army of the Truni Empire on the opposite side was in chaos.

"The queen is dead... The queen is dead..."

Ayub no longer cared so much and directly ordered the whole army to attack.

The result of the battle was naturally no suspense.

In less than a day, the capital of the Truni Empire was captured.

The first battle was a victory, and Wang Shuo rewarded the whole army.

Next was the Parthian Empire.

On the morning of the second day, the peace envoys of the Parthian Empire came to the Truni Empire and found Wang Shuo.

"Your Majesty, I am here to negotiate peace on the orders of His Majesty Andre."

Wang Shuo laughed and looked at the rather nervous envoy, and said lightly: "Oh? Tell me, Andre, what conditions have you put forward?"

"Our country is willing to cede half of its territory, and I hope Your Majesty can stop the war."

Wang Shuo laughed heartily, and all the generals in the hall laughed along.

Seeing that Wang Shuo did not speak, the envoy continued: "If Your Majesty is not satisfied, His Majesty Andre is willing to become your vassal state and pay tribute to you."

After Wang Shuo laughed enough, he still shook his head.

The envoy saw Wang Shuo shaking his head, as if he had lost all his strength at once.

"Go back and tell Andre to wash his neck and wait!"

"If he had known this would happen, why didn't he agree when the Frost Empire negotiated peace?"

The messenger walked out of the hall in a daze, and almost stumbled when he passed the threshold.

Wang Shuo did not accept the surrender of these two countries, just to make Ye Xueer understand.

Three months later.

Wang Shuo's army arrived at the Luoxia Plain.

"Report, the army of the Parthian Empire appeared in front."

Wang Shuo was a little surprised. It can be seen that Andre was fighting a desperate battle.

Luoxia Plain is more than 100 miles away from the capital of the Parthian Empire, but this place has a wide terrain and can accommodate tens of millions of troops.

This is the battlefield chosen by Andre. He has already built a large number of fortifications on the opposite side.

Wang Shuo rode on the back of the Ice Phoenix, flew high into the sky, and inspected along the Luoxia Plain.

On the plain, countless armies set up camp.

Wang Shuo was a little puzzled.

Logically speaking, the Parthian Empire should not have so many troops.
